LanguageData.MoveBase_SettingsSmartDependencyLabel: Smart dependency placement (conduits/floors first, dependencies respected)
LanguageData.MoveBase_SettingsSmartDependencyDesc: When enabled, placement uses deterministic tiers: conduits first, then floors, then structures/dependencies. This prevents most placement errors.
LanguageData.MoveBase_SettingsSkipItemsLabel: Skip items that can't be placed (instead of aborting entire move)
LanguageData.MoveBase_SettingsSkipItemsDesc: When enabled, items that have placement errors will be skipped. When disabled, the entire move will be cancelled if any item can't be placed.
LanguageData.MoveBase_SettingsShowSkippedDesc: Display a message listing items that were skipped due to errors.
LanguageData.MoveBase_SettingsCopyFloorsDesc: When enabled, queues construction of floors at the destination to match the selected area.
LanguageData.MoveBase_SettingsHandleObstructionsDesc: Designate plants for cutting/harvest, mineables for mining, and player buildings for uninstall when they block move placement.
LanguageData.MoveBase_SettingsAutoUninstallDesc: When enabled, blocking player structures that can be minified are designated for uninstall automatically.
LanguageData.MoveBase_SettingsWarnNonMinifiableDesc: Show warning messages for blockers that cannot be automatically moved.
LanguageData.MoveBase_SettingsQueueRoofDesc: When enabled, source roof pattern is mirrored as Build Roof designations at the destination.
LanguageData.MoveBase_SettingsAllowThickRoofLabel: Allow moves under thick roof (ignore thick-roof migration)
LanguageData.MoveBase_SettingsAllowThickRoofDesc: When enabled, thick mountain roofs no longer block move operations. Thick-roof migration bookkeeping is skipped.
